raw_text: EU DisinfoLab investigation confirms Pakistani state-linked network targeting Indian elections 2024. The operation mirrors previously documented 'Indian Chronicles' tactics but with updated platform strategies. Bot accounts demonstrated coordinated posting schedules aligned with IST prime hours. Network shutdown recommended to platform trust and safety teams.
